1_3._doc: [anvil 1_3 HD, v1.10.92] Anchor & Anvil: CC0 Poly Haven swaps for the big homogeneous materials (quay slabs, ground, asphalt, brick and stained concrete walls), repeats chosen so the pattern keeps real-world scale against the disc's texel size; blur 0.012-0.02 keeps the disc's own stains / drips / lichen patches; 'lines' keeps the disc's straight joints (slab joints, string courses); 'out' caps texture memory. Everything else takes the careful upscale (fl_texmap.json 1_3). Corrugated sheets (3ef00 roofs, 1e400 pen roof) were tried with corrugated_iron_02 and withdrawn after the in-game stills: the CC0 ribs are finer than the disc's and wash out to a flat grey at play distance, losing the sheet look - they keep the upscale.
